title: The Forsaken Debris
survival_class: Unsafe / Unsecure / Non-entity hazards (no numeric class)
physical_identity: A skyscraping rock ('Geolith') in a calm, endless ocean under a gray, empty, permanently lit sky, topped by a derelict concrete lighthouse 47 m above the water.
scale_topology: Outdoor open ocean with one rock; lighthouse has ground floor, upper floor, exterior roof/Lamp Zone; interior larger than exterior.
anomalies: fixed time of day with unknown light source
lighting_sound: Uniform light gray daylight, no sun; dim lighthouse interior; only wave sounds; wind currents.
hazards: pressure valve, panel implosion, explosion and fire (testimony)

entrances.from: any sailor-style or marine-navigation door in the Backrooms
entrances.method: slim chance of no-clip to lighthouse entrance
entrances.quote: there is a slim possibility of no-clipping to the entrance of the Lighthouse

entrances.method: wander far in ocean, blinding light, arrive in front of lighthouse
entrances.conditions: slight chance; only when no one else inside
entrances.quote: a slight chance of witnessing a blinding light on the heights above the distant horizon

exits.method: jump from rock then swim several hours once rock is out of sight
exits.quote: swimming through the Ocean for several hours in an undetermined direction

signature_mechanic: Lone-wanderer rock and lighthouse; hidden rising pressure leads to gas leak, then explosion and fire (testimony hypothesis); only exit is to jump and swim.
verticality: Lighthouse 47 m above sea; rock continues to sea bottom; lighthouse has two floors plus roof.
conflicts_notes: Footnotes 1-3 are referenced but their text is missing from the snapshot. Exit destination level not named in Exits; Level 7 inferred. Valve closing outcome unanswered. Panel/valve/fire details are testimony.
